name: Swords and Sandals VR
summary:
Gladiator, are you ready to unleash hell in the arena in VR?

The world's favourite gladiator game has returned, now in virtual reality!  For the first time ever, YOU ARE IN THE ARENA! See through the eyes of your gladiator, hear the roar of the crowd surrounding you.

Enter the Arena of Doomtrek and do battle with the best gladiators in the realm. Game features:

* Fast tactical combat, brutal hits and limb loss.
